hints.content: The ratio of shaded pieces to total pieces is $\goldD{11}:25$.

Percent means per hundred.  

So, we need an equivalent ratio that will tell us how many pieces would be shaded out of $100$ total pieces.

|||
-|-|-|-
Shaded | $\goldE{11}$ | $\stackrel{\times 4}\rightarrow$ | $\goldE{44}$
Parts per whole | $25$ | $\stackrel{\times 4}\rightarrow$  | $100$
$\goldD{44}\%$ is represented by the shaded area.
